verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's source is hosted publicly on GitHub (opentofu-gh-1, opentofu-gh-2) and the manifesto explicitly commits to it remaining 'Truly open source' under Linux Foundation governance (opentofu-docs-26, opentofu-docs-23). Community confirms the license is easily found in the GitHub repo, even if not surfaced on the marketing site (opentofu-comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit citation of the license name/text (e.g., MPL 2.0) in the evidence pack, and no independent legal/audit confirmation beyond community mention.
